instruction:
Use the ANSYS Workbench GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: simply supported beam under a mid-span step load, find maximum dynamic deflection.

Model parameters:
- Beam cross section 20 mm x 20 mm, length 1000 mm
- Material: Structural Steel
- Mesh: element size 50 mm

Boundary conditions and load:
- Left end: simply supported (Y=0, Z=0)
- Right end: roller support (Y=0, Z=0, X free)
- Midpoint: step force 1000 N in Y direction, duration 0.05 s
- Time step: 0.001 s

Analysis type: Transient Structural with large deflection enabled

Save requirements:
- Workbench project file: wb_transient.wbpj
- The project directory must include transient result files
